## Sales Metrics and KPIs

### Rep Performance Indicators
- Conversion rate (meetings → trials → orders)
- Average deal size (monthly recurring value)
- Compliance program enrollments
- Reorder rate (retention)
- Call-to-close time (time-focus metric)

### Budget-Focused Metrics
- Cost per acquisition (CPA) for new clinic accounts
- Revenue per call (efficiency)
- Margin protection (not over-discounting)
- ROI per clinic (annual value vs. cost to service)

---
